name: ZenZap
summary: Secure work-chat for teams — organized channels, built-in tasks and workflows, AI agents and admin controls, as easy to use as texting.
best_for: small teams that run work over messy WhatsApp/personal chat today and want organized, professional chat with tasks — starting free
skip_if: your workflows depend on a deep integration ecosystem (Slack's moat), or you're already paid into Microsoft Teams via 365
honest_knock: The pricing genuinely undercuts Slack — the honest question is ecosystem: team chat lives or dies on integrations and habit, and ZenZap's app catalog is a fraction of Slack's, so teams glued to hundreds of integrations will feel the gap. For WhatsApp-refugee teams that mainly need organized channels, tasks and work/life separation, the free tier is a remarkably complete landing spot.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-01 against the vendor's own pricing page) (2026) Free plan: unlimited group chats, unlimited built-in to-dos, WhatsApp chat migration, AI voice-note transcription and in-chat search, 1 GB storage — the page publishes no user cap for it and no promise of unlimited seats. Pro $3/user/mo billed yearly ($4 monthly); Business+ $8/user yearly ($10 monthly); Enterprise custom. Flat-rate team bundles price below per-seat: Pro is $51/mo yearly for up to 20 users and $112 for up to 50, Business+ $89 and $190, quoted in dollars and pounds. Yearly billing saves 33%. Integrations with business tools and API access start at Business+; audit logs, SSO and SAML/SCIM are Enterprise.
